calls.title: GrowthBook x Legend | Next Steps (Kick Off)
calls.summary: The meeting outlined the onboarding strategy for implementing GrowthBook across three main pillars: Gaming, Sports, and Money. The Gaming pillar will employ shared projects for its multi-application environment, while the Sports and Money pillars will focus on distinct domains with dedicated engineering teams. Discussions included the implementation of SDKs across various platforms, primarily starting with web technologies, and highlighted the data integration process with Snowflake for analytics purposes. Notably, access management will be centralized through SSO and IDP integrations. The timeline anticipates experimentation completion by the end of July, with structured developer enablement programs planned to guide teams through SDK implementation and validation processes.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, SDK implementation, experimentation, onboarding, SSO integration, Snowflake
